newsitem.title: INDIA: Jailed Indian politician has heart trouble.
newsitem.headline: Jailed Indian politician has heart trouble.

text.p: A popular Indian politician detained in a corruption scandal is suffering from "serious heart ailment," his doctor said on Sunday.

Naresh Trehan, chief of New Delhi's Escorts heart institute, who flew to the eastern city of Patna to examine former Bihar chief minister Laloo Prasad Yadav, said one of Yadav's heart valves was not functioning properly and his blood pressure was dangerously high.

Indicted by federal investigators in a $280 million state farm funds scandal, Yadav, 49, was forced to quit as chief minister of Bihar, one of India's poorest states on July 25 when his detention became imminent.
He named his unschooled wife Rabri Devi as his successor and was housed in air-conditioned comfort in a police guest house converted to makeshift prison.
Yadav was taken to a hospital last Wednesday complaining of "uneasiness and breathlessness".
